name: moras
description: > MBTI + 사주 기반 이벤트 매칭 웹 애플리케이션

scripts.build:netlify: mkdir -p public/assets/marketing/upcoming-event public/assets/marketing/promo public/assets/guide public/assets/sound netlify-build/functions && printf 'Moras runs through Netlify Functions.\n' > public/index.html && cp assets/marketing/upcoming-event/moras-upcoming-event-mbti-saju-v1.png public/assets/marketing/upcoming-event/moras-upcoming-event-mbti-saju-v1.png && cp assets/marketing/promo/*.png public/assets/marketing/promo/ && cp assets/guide/*.png public/assets/guide/ && cp assets/sound/*.mp3 public/assets/sound/ && esbuild netlify/functions/moras.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=netlify-build/functions/moras.mjs
